svg.text: Signed distance from each comparable exon–domain boundary to the nearest representative-domain edge, per species
Do the species place the same comparable boundary at the same distance, and on the same side, of the nearest domain edge?
Signed distance to nearest representative-domain edge (aa) · 0 = domain edge
Bar: observed range · vertical tick: median · raw observations always shown
Open marker: distance to a domain start edge · filled marker: to a domain end edge · negative: upstream of that edge
